answer: Verifiable-delay-function minting resists sybils: each identity must compute a VDF — an inherently SEQUENTIAL computation that cannot be parallelized across cores or machines, taking fixed wall-clock time per key. A trellis of fakes cannot thread them through parallel hardware: ten thousand VDFs are ten thousand serial waits, and the nebula of cloud cores an attacker rents buys no speedup because the thread of each computation depends on its own prior step. Honest agents pay one sequential delay; a farm pays the delay per identity in series.
